key_insight: ClinVerse moves medical-agent training and evaluation beyond static questions into interactive diagnostic simulations grounded in real-world health records.
clinical_relevance: The environment tests how AI agents gather patient information, request examinations, and form diagnoses, without establishing readiness for clinical use.
method: Supports coordinated interactions among six specialized clinical roles.
Doctor agents interview simulated patients and request examinations before diagnosing.
Rule-based trajectory scores measure information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy.
evidence_signal: Built on ClinPatient’s 150,000 EHR-derived diagnostic cases, ClinVerse evaluated general-purpose and medical models and reported improvements from nine self-evolution methods across three categories.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish whether gains in simulation translate to safe, effective performance in real clinical settings.
paper_title: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
